name: Cart Upsell
summary: Named target-controlled recommendation list with optional canonical Link, Price, and Button composition per item.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named section rendered only for a non-empty title and recommendation list.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible heading that names the recommendation region through aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Native unordered list of target-authored recommendations.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item for one target recommendation.

anatomy.name: itemImage
anatomy.description: Optional target media; decorative when adjacent identity repeats its meaning.

anatomy.name: itemInfo
anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for product identity and optional canonical Price.

anatomy.name: itemTitle
anatomy.description: Non-empty product identity rendered as text or canonical Link when a truthful destination exists.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Price composition with complete target-formatted content.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Button for a target-supported per-item request.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic compact layout with container-responsive item reflow.

states.name: default
states.description: Controlled projection of a non-empty target recommendation collection.

behavior.name: namedRegion
behavior.description: The non-empty visible heading supplies the section's accessible name through a unique target-generated ID.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Recommendations use ul and li without custom list, selection, widget, or keyboard semantics.

behavior.name: itemComposition
behavior.description: Each item independently composes target identity, optional canonical Link, optional canonical Price, and optional canonical Button.

behavior.name: contextualActions
behavior.description: Repeated item actions require contextual accessible names and per-item availability/pending truth owned by the target.

behavior.name: recommendations
behavior.description: Targets own source, intent, ranking, tracking destination, item availability, variant selection, formatting, and refresh lifecycle.

behavior.name: targetOwnedResults
behavior.description: K6 is not a live region and owns no optimistic state; the parent target confirms outcomes, updates cart truth, announces results, and applies its focus policy.

behavior.name: emptyOmission
behavior.description: Blank title or zero valid recommendations omits the complete component instead of exposing an empty named region.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty localized heading that names the recommendation region.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Non-empty target-authored recommendation list composition; per-item Link, Price, Button, availability, and pending state remain inside the slot.

accessibility: Render a section labelled by its non-empty visible heading only when at least one valid recommendation exists.
Use native ul and li semantics; do not add a listbox, selection model, roving focus, carousel, or custom keyboard behavior.
Render product navigation through canonical Link and add requests through canonical Button; each repeated action needs a product-specific accessible name.
Use canonical Price for complete target-formatted and bidirectionally isolated price meaning.
Use empty alternative text for media that repeats adjacent product identity; provide concise target text only when media adds information.
Keep K6 out of live regions. Announce confirmed cart results and errors in one parent target status surface without unexpected focus movement.
Omit direct add when target variant or availability rules cannot support it truthfully; a navigation-only recommendation is valid.
Preserve canonical Link, Button, Price, forced-colors, focus-visible, disabled, busy, and reduced-motion behavior.

web.notes: Neutral layout and semantics implemented in components/css/cart.css; target supplies items and behavior.

shopify.notes: Recommendation source, cart placement, product-recommendation request context, variant/add policy, merchant settings, refresh, tracking, status, and editor proof remain open target decisions.
